method: curl (browser User-Agent); endpoint read from votewa-vg.js
notes: VoteWA voter-guide measure JSON for City of Milton Proposition No. 1. KCE's eid=55 list links Milton to http://voter.votewa.gov/genericvoterguide.aspx?e=899&c=27&language=en#/measure/7310 (c=27 is Pierce County, which administers Milton) instead of a KCE cid page; that page is an Angular shell whose script (Scripts/votewa-vg.js) loads this endpoint with params m, e, la, c. Carries BallotTitle, ExplanatoryStatement, ArgumentFor/Against, Rebuttals. The same statements are printed in the King local pamphlet (City of Milton section).
